newsitem.title: USA: Aurient to explore near Dizon Mine.
newsitem.headline: Aurient to explore near Dizon Mine.

text.p: Aurient Resources Ltd said Monday it signed a memorandum of understanding with Pisumpan Copper Mines Inc of the Philippines for the joint exploration and potential development of the Kundipit porphyry gold copper prospect and surrounding area in Pampanga Province, Luzon.
Pisumpan's President Juvencio Dizon is a principal of Dizon Copper Silver Mines Inc.

The project lies 10 kilometers northeast of the Dizon Mine, a 100 million ton porphyry gold copper deposit that has been operating successfully since it began operations in 1980 with high gold credits by world standards, Aurient said.

Aurient said it agreed to reimburse Pisumpan the sum of US $250,000 for exploration costs to be incurred on a mutually agreed work program begun in November 1996 and which is scheduled to continue until the wet season in May.
The partners will form a joint venture company in the Philippines in which Aurient said it will hold a 40 percent equity stake and continue to provide exploration funding over a three year period.
Upon Aurient's contributions reaching US $4 million its equity stake will increase to 50 percent, Aurient said.
Thereafter, Aurient said it may increase its equity interest to 70 percent if Pisumpan elects not to contribute to subsequent expenditures.
